evidence.evidence: Development experiments are performed using the TREC-6 ad hoc text retrieval task and performance is measured using the TREC-7 ad hoc task.
Development experiments are performed using the TREC-6 ad hoc text retrieval task and performance is measured using the TREC-7 ad hoc task.
Official evaluation results on the 1999 TREC-8 ad hoc task are also reported.

The document likelihoods are computed using statistical language modeling techniques and the model parameters are estimated automatically and dynamically for each query to optimize well-specified (maximum likelihood) objective functions.
